Visible labels: BELT CONVEYOR SYSTEM – L1 QUICK REFERENCE | CHP INTERN SAFETY CARD; COAL FLOW (End-to-End); Wagon → Tippler → Hopper → Feeder → BC-1 → Transfer → BC-2 → Bunker → Boiler; KEY COMPONENTS & FUNCTION; Belt: carries coal (carry + return loop); Drive Pulley: powered pulley at HEAD end; Tail Pulley: free pulley at FEED end; Idlers: support belt; troughed = more capacity; Take-up: maintains correct belt tension; Scraper: removes carryback at head end; EPC: Emergency Pull Cord — full length STOP; BSW: Belt Sway Switch — drift detection; ZSS: Zero Speed Switch — slip detection; CAPACITY DEPENDS ON:; • Belt width (800–1400 mm typical); • Belt speed (1.2–2.5 m/s typical); • Trough angle (20°–45°); • Inclination (max 15–18° for coal); • Coal density & moisture content; WAGON TIPPLER TYPES:; Rotary; 150–160° flip; Side Discharge; 45–60° tilt; Track Hopper; Bottom discharge; CONTROL POINTS:; CP1: Feed point — uniform loading; CP2: Transfer point — highest risk zone; CP3: Drive pulley — power + friction; CP4: Belt alignment — drift = damage; CP5: Bunker discharge — fuel supply end; 🔴 HAZARD ZONES — HIGHEST RISK; ZONE; HAZARD TYPE; CONSEQUENCE; Head/Tail Pulley; Nip/Pinch point; Crush / Amputation; Belt Surface; Entanglement; Degloving / Fatality; Transfer Tower; Confined space + dust; Asphyxia / Impact; Feed Point; Impact from coal; Blunt trauma; Coal Spillage; Slip / Trip; Fall / Fracture; Coal Dust (all zones); Respiratory / Fire; CWP / Explosion; PPE REQUIRED IN CHP:; ⛑ Safety Helmet | 👟 Steel-toe Boots; 🦺 Hi-Vis Vest | 😷 Dust Mask (P2 min); 🥽 Safety Glasses | Close-fitting Coveralls; ⚠ Remove loose gloves near rotating parts; KEY FAILURE CONSEQUENCES:; Belt drift → fire → belt loss + outage; Overload → spillage → motor trip → coal backup; Chute block → conveyor trip → bunker starves; Belt slip → overheating → fire at drive end; Dust accumulation → fire / explosion risk; Entanglement → serious injury / fatality; 🆘 EMERGENCY ACTIONS; 1. Entanglement / injury → Pull EPC immediately; 2. Fire / smoke → Pull EPC + raise fire alarm; 3. Blockage / unusual noise → Inform supervisor; 4. Seizure / burning smell → Do NOT touch; report; 5. NEVER restart a tripped conveyor yourself; STOPPED ≠ SAFE; Confirm LOTO before approaching any stopped conveyor; SITE OBSERVATION CHECKLIST; Walk belt → tick healthy / flag abnormal:; ☐ Belt centred on idlers (no drift); ☐ All idlers spinning (no seizures); ☐ Belt surface intact (no rips); ☐ No coal spillage on walkway; ☐ No burning smell; ☐ EPC ropes intact both sides; ☐ All guards in place (pulleys); ☐ Scraper in contact with belt; ☐ No blocked chute (sound check); ☐ Motor noise normal (steady hum); ☐ No dust cloud beyond normal; → Any abnormality: REPORT IMMEDIATELY; DO ✔; Wear full PPE always; Walk in buddy pairs; Stay on designated walkways; Report all abnormalities; Pull EPC without hesitation in emergency; Know nearest EPC location before entering; DON'T ✘; Touch moving belt; Lean over running conveyor; Remove any guard; Enter confined space without permit; Operate any equipment independently; Bypass safety devices; Work alone in CHP gallery / tower; Thermal Power Plant | Coal Handling Plant | L1 Intern Safety Reference Card; This card is for awareness only. 2. Fire / smoke → Pull EPC + raise fire alarm
4. Seizure / burning smell → Do NOT touch; report
5. NEVER restart a tripped conveyor yourself
Confirm LOTO before approaching any stopped conveyor
Walk belt → tick healthy / flag abnormal:
Pull EPC without hesitation in emergency

metadata.caption: Quick Reference Card — L1 Belt Conveyor (Print करने योग्य)
svg_text_labels: L1 Belt Conveyor — Quick Reference Card
Coal Handling Plant · Thermal Power Plant · L1 Foundational
Drive Pulley — friction से belt move
EPC — full length; pull = instant stop
FC1 Belt Drift: Off-centre load → BSW alarm → reduce feed, adjust idlers
FC2 Overloading: Feeder gate too open → spillage → reduce feed rate
FC3 Chute Blockage: Wet coal → backup → stop upstream belt FIRST, then clear
FC4 Belt Slip: Low tension / oily pulley → ZSS trip → check tension + pulley
FC5 Dust Fire: Seized idler + spill coal → fire → EPC + evacuate + CO₂/DCP
FC6 Entanglement: No LOTO / loose clothing → PREVENT: LOTO हमेशा, no exceptions
1. Notify control room 2. Stop conveyor 3. Open isolator + personal padlock लगाएं
4. "DO NOT OPERATE" tag 5. Test: Start press करें — confirm no movement 6. काम करें
7. Lock + tag हटाएं 8. Control room को notify करें
